ordering: odd pairs baseline then bridge; even pairs bridge then baseline

probe.method: Alternating fresh ConPTY pwsh processes; UTF-8 console and history saving disabled in both cases. The baseline wraps the profile's existing prompt and emits a controlled marker after its output; the adapter source is reported above. Prompt marker timestamp, not first visible frame. OS caches are not cleared. Query timings include PSReadLine + OSC + ConPTY roundtrip. This does not measure outer-host rendering or RSS.
